Record Class HoldingWithCost

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
app.holding.HoldingWithCost
Record Components:
holding - the cached position
instrument - the instrument held, or null when no instrument row matches
averageCost - average price paid per share, or null when no fill history explains the position
public record HoldingWithCost(Holding holding, Instrument instrument, BigDecimal averageCost) extends Record
A position together with what it is in and what it cost.

Neither the instrument nor the cost is on the holding row, so this carries the three pieces a client needs as one value and keeps the assembling query in the service rather than the controller.
